items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: the early big guard came and asked me if I wanted to work with him

ctx.x: Yeah, he played with me. Listen, I want to jump of it Dick, because you can probably fill it in later. I want to get the story on this, when we were working with Mr. Highdown out there, so I'll jump to that. Talking about when you went into the Melody Inn, you know. How did that job come about? I mean who hired you to play that job?
Well from what I can remember, I hope I have it right, the early big guard came and asked me if I wanted to work with him. So, well I had been playing with big bands before then.

Well let me tell you the story. You know more about it than me. Elec went to Peterson's music store to see about some drumsticks or something. And Peterson said, Elec, you all playing anywhere? No. They want a band down at the Melody Inn for Mr. Highdown. So, Elec said, you know, you can go and see about the job. So, Elec called me and asked me about the job. And he said, you know, you can go and see about it. So, I told him, go and see about it. So, he got lying there, I got joys getting off, and myself to go…
